verses.1: Alley for me, for I was like a scorpion; I was like a poisonous snake. There was no place to eat in the pit. My soul was in despair.
verses.2: A righteous man was lost from the earth. All of them became like bloodthirsty beasts. Each person would harm his neighbor. They were cursed by God.
verses.3: On the evil one, with a mouth that is good at asking questions and judging fairly. He is the one whose soul is pure.
verses.4: May they be like a solid pillar, strong and stable, even in the day of crisis. Your punishment has now arrived; it will surely come true.
verses.5: Do not trust your enemies. Do not rely on those who are hidden in the depths of your own heart. Keep your lips sealed.
verses.6: For a son of a prostitute, a daughter was born to his mother. She was born in her mother’s womb. His enemies were the people of his house.
verses.7: I hope that in the Lord, I will be heard and my prayers will be listened to by my God.
verses.8: Do not be sad, for I have fallen. But I will rise again, as if I were sitting in darkness. May the Lord give me light.
verses.9: The LORD will be angry with me because of my sins. But when my enemies fight against me, he will judge me fairly and bring me out from darkness into light. Then I will see his righteousness.
verses.10: And you will see my suffering, and it will be covered by the words “My God, Jehovah, my Lord!” My eyes will see it now. It will become a source of sorrow, like a broken piece of pottery.
verses.11: The day of planting your trees will come soon. That day will be far away.
verses.12: On that day, Ashur will come to me. The cities of Mazar will also be under my control. I will rule over them, along with the river and the sea. And the mountain will also be under my control.
verses.13: And the earth would become like a bed for its inhabitants, with their fruits growing upon it.
verses.14: May your people be blessed in your reign. May your inheritance be preserved for you. May I be left alone, in a forest within the vineyard. May they be destroyed by the teeth and claws of time.
verses.15: In the days when you left the land of Egypt, we will see wonders.
verses.16: All nations will be terrified and tremble with fear. They will put their hands on their mouths; their ears will be deafened.
verses.17: Let them tremble like scorpions on the earth. Let them cry out from their hiding places to our God, our Lord. Let them be afraid and respect you.
verses.18: Who else can bear the burden of sins and mistakes for the rest of their lives? They won’t be able to keep them forever. For He desires mercy.
verses.19: May our Lord come back and forgive our sins. May He cast away all their evil deeds into the depths of the sea.
verses.20: Give Jacob truth, and grant Abraham mercy. For he was blessed by our ancestors since ancient times.
